data.headline: Ready for ten games of Cash Bingo?
body: There are cash prizes throughout, plus a final jackpot that grows with every book sold. Book your seats, bring £10 cash per player and get ready for eyes down at 7pm.

data.heading: New to bingo? You’ll be right at home.
body: The numbers are shown on the pub TVs, so every game is easy to follow whether you play regularly or this is your first time. Dabbers are available to buy at the pub if you need one.
Come down early, grab some food and a drink, then settle in before the first game. The full menu is available from 4pm to 9pm.

data.body: Book ahead to secure your seats, then bring £10 cash for each book on the night.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
